ipa.surfaces.cap.SurfaceFilters

Filter object for surface.

Available as lseg.data.content.ipa.surfaces.cap.SurfaceFilters.

Syntax

SurfaceFilters(
    *,
    maturity_filter_range: MaturityFilter | None = None,
    strike_range: StrikeFilterRange | None = None,
    strike_range_percent=None,
    atm_tolerance_interval_percent: OptFloat = None,
    ensure_prices_monotonicity: OptBool = None,
    max_of_median_bid_ask_spread: OptFloat = None,
    max_staleness_days: OptInt = None,
    use_only_calls: OptBool = None,
    use_only_puts: OptBool = None,
    use_weekly_options: OptBool = None,
    include_min_tick_prices: OptBool = None,
)

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
maturity_filter_range MaturityFilter | None No None The object allows to specify the range of expiry periods of options that are used to construct the surface.
strike_range StrikeFilterRange | None No None The range allows to exclude strike levels that have implied volatilities which exceed upper bound or below lower bound.
strike_range_percent No None This attribute doesn't use anymore.
atm_tolerance_interval_percent OptFloat No None Filter on the atm tolerance interval percent
ensure_prices_monotonicity OptBool No None Filter on the monotonicity of price options.
max_of_median_bid_ask_spread OptFloat No None Spread mutltiplier to filter the options with the same expiry
max_staleness_days OptInt No None Max staleness past days to use for building the surface
use_only_calls OptBool No None Select only teh calls to build the surface
use_only_puts OptBool No None Select only the puts to build the surface
use_weekly_options OptBool No None Filter on the weekly options.
include_min_tick_prices OptBool No None Take into account the minimum tick prices to build the surface
